blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A working data protection programme is not a document — it is a small set of ongoing activities. Data is mapped and inventoried. Purposes are recorded. Consent is managed. Retention is enforced. Requests from individuals — for access, correction, or deletion — are handled within legal deadlines.

We have built a simple register of every dataset the company holds. For each one, we have documented the purpose, the legal basis, and who owns it. We have set retention rules and automatic deletion where appropriate. The whole programme fits on three pages — and it has already answered two regulator questions calmly, with evidence.

The goal is never to be perfect. It is to be organised and honest — the two qualities regulators value most, and the two that make every other part of compliance far easier to live with.

items.q: According to the text, a working data protection programme is essentially…
options: a small set of ongoing activities
items.why: "it is a small set of ongoing activities" — não é um documento estático.

items.q: What has the team documented for each dataset in the register?
options: The author and the date only
The file size and the storage cost
The purpose, the legal basis, and who owns it
The market value and the buyer
items.why: "we have documented the purpose, the legal basis, and who owns it."

items.q: How does the text describe the goal of the programme?
options: To be as long as possible
items.why: "It is to be organised and honest — the two qualities regulators value most."

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: A longer, more detailed report always proves better compliance.
Handling requests on time is part of the programme.
Retention rules should be enforced, not just written down.
A short, honest programme can reassure a regulator.
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza três páginas honestas acima de relatórios longos — comprimento não prova conformidade.

items.q: The fact that the programme "has already answered two regulator questions calmly, with evidence" suggests that…
options: the register makes it easy to respond quickly and confidently
the company is being investigated for a breach
the programme still needs to be much longer
items.why: Inferência: ter tudo registrado com evidência permite responder ao regulador com calma e rapidez.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte apresentando o programa ao auditor. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
I can see you were expecting something rather heavier — a two-hundred-page report, perhaps. What I have brought you is three pages. I promise that is not because we have cut corners.

Everything you need is in this register. We have mapped every dataset the company holds. For each one, we have recorded the purpose, the legal basis, and the person who owns it. We have set retention rules, and where it is sensible, deletion happens automatically. Nothing sits in a drawer waiting to be forgotten.

Since we launched this in January, we have handled every access and deletion request inside the legal deadline. We have already answered two questions from your office, and we answered them with evidence, not with promises. That, honestly, is the whole point. We are not trying to be perfect. We are trying to be organised and honest — and to show you exactly where the data lives and why.

So please, ask me anything. If it is in the register, I can find it in seconds. If it is not, I would rather tell you that now than pretend otherwise.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What had the auditor expected instead of the three-page programme?
items.why: "you were expecting something rather heavier — a two-hundred-page report, perhaps."

items.q: Since launching the programme in January, what has the team done with individual requests?
options: Handled every request inside the legal deadline
Passed them to an external lawyer
items.why: "we have handled every access and deletion request inside the legal deadline."

items.q: How did Charlotte answer the two questions from the auditor's office?
items.why: "we answered them with evidence, not with promises."

items.q: When Charlotte says "that is not because we have cut corners", she is trying to…
options: reassure the auditor that short does not mean careless
items.why: Inferência: ela antecipa a suspeita de que três páginas signifiquem trabalho malfeito e a desarma.

items.q: What does Charlotte's willingness to say "If it is not, I would rather tell you that now" reveal about her approach?
options: She values honesty over appearing flawless
She is hiding gaps in the data
She has not read the register
She expects the audit to fail
items.why: Inferência: preferir admitir uma lacuna a fingir mostra que a honestidade é o valor central do programa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Before we set any rules, we need to inventory every dataset we hold." To inventory means to…
options: make a complete list of it
sell it to a third party
items.why: To inventory = inventariar: listar e catalogar tudo o que existe.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We can only keep the data for the ___ we originally recorded — nothing else."
items.why: Purpose = finalidade: o motivo declarado para se ter os dados.

items.q: "The customer withdrew their consent, so we stopped emailing them." Consent is…
items.why: Consent = consentimento: a permissão dada pela pessoa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Our ___ rules mean old records are deleted automatically after five years."
items.why: Retention = retenção: por quanto tempo os dados são guardados antes de serem apagados.

items.q: "We must answer the access request within the legal deadline." A legal deadline is…
options: the time limit the law sets
items.why: Legal deadline = prazo legal: o limite de tempo que a lei impõe para responder.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre proteção de dados. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The DPO still has to sign off on the retention rules." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new register to every department next quarter." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two teams pushed back on the automatic deletion rule." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "Everyone agreed to update the register, but nobody followed through." They…
options: failed to finish what they promised
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado; aqui não foi feito.

items.q: "A three-page programme won't move the needle unless people actually use it." To move the needle means to…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.
